method: First audited the 20 pre-R05 published first-floor images against the four labeled model-home photos, a fresh rendering of blueprint PDF page 2, actual entrance/exterior evidence and explicit homeowner corrections. Then visually reviewed 16 replacement Higgsfield image-edit candidates (eight day and eight same-camera night views); final selections/job IDs are cross-referenced to docs/first-floor-r05-production.json. Four previously audited empty-gym views are retained. A visual QA pass establishes design-image coherence only; reverse elevations are interpretive and dimensions, clearances, construction details, products and physical samples require field verification.
evidenceRules: Original photographs govern photographed primary camera, room proportions and observed openings. Explicit homeowner actual-house corrections govern new requested glazing and portico-window elevation.
Derived reverse cameras use blueprint adjacencies and their corresponding approved primary; they are interpretations rather than measured elevations.
Nights inherit the evidence role and architecture of their exact paired days.
Printed-plan coordinates and camera left/right are separate: reversing the camera reverses image left/right.
